text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It was truly a meaningful day off.
I appreciate your thoughtfulness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I was able to clear up quite a backlog of tasks!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Oops, it's not that I wasn't resting, you know?
Naturally, I indulged in physical rest as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However, "spending one's time freely" can also serve as a mental respite.
And so, Symboli Rudolf spent her day off in a manner most befitting herself.
